Teacher arm adds weight 0.1 of log1p((mean-free pressure discrepancy / frozen eight-pass correction L2 / 1e-6)^2). Acceptance thresholds unchanged.
method: Diagnose remaining pressure and equation error after 1/2/4/8 passes on original training parents only, split by spatial mode and signal amplitude.

stage: Three matched 1500-update CUDA fits, exact fresh CPU restores, five-model isolated 128-case pass sweeps, frozen diagnostic selection, eight independent native/C53/C59 four/eight-pass scene campaigns, postfit spectral diagnosis and chart verification completed. No model promoted.
diagnosis: After four passes, low spatial modes contain 99.80% (C53) and 99.77% (C55) of remaining pressure-error energy. Coefficients below 1e-4 of original full correction L2 contribute about 0.0010% and 0.00055% of that error respectively; this supports targeting coherent low-mode correction rather than assuming weak-signal noise is dominant.

normalization: New log-equation training feedback divides by the initial correction-request residual L2. Snapshot and native physical qualification divide by the full pressure RHS L2. Acceptance remains 1e-6 in the latter convention.
